prompt: Thiết kế mobile app iOS Android và tạo prototype chạy trên trình duyệt để khách bấm thử bằng link GitHub Pages. Có branch_write; chưa có quyền deploy.
expected_outcomes: Reuse target renderer and state rather than disconnected screen copies
Verify browser interactions and static-host base paths
Prepare hosting assets and explicitly pending URL without inventing deployment or native QA
must_not: Treat browser PASS as native runtime or actual participant evidence
Claim a PREPARED package is a delivered live demo
